fields.options:
Before enabling: register on AFIP (Argentina) and upload the resulting certificate/key here.
  1. Log in with your Clave Fiscal at auth.afip.gob.ar (level 3 required).
  2. Go to Administrador de Certificados Digitales and generate a CSR (or use openssl req -new -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout private.key -out request.csr locally), then upload the .csr there to get a .crt back.
  3. Go to Administrador de Relaciones de Clave Fiscal, create a new relation for your CUIT, service WSFEv1 (Factura Electrónica), and attach the certificate from step 2.
  4. Go to Regímenes de Facturación y Registros Especiales → Puntos de Venta and register a Punto de Venta of type "Web Services" (not manual). Use that number below.
  5. Upload the .crt as Certificate and the matching .key (from step 2) as Private Key below, fill in CUIT and Punto de Venta, then enable.
  6. Test against Homologación first (AFIP's sandbox needs a separate test certificate, generated the same way at wsass-homo.afip.gob.ar) before switching Environment to Producción.
